svg.title: How the pictures are made
svg.desc: scripts/screenshots.sh builds the extension and starts the pinned Playwright image with the repository read-only. Inside, run.sh installs the Inter font and the tools, and capture.py opens the stage in Chromium. The stage shows the real popup or switcher of the extension in a frame, with a stand-in for Chrome and made-up accounts; every file comes from the repository and no request leaves the browser. capture.py takes each picture at a fixed size, scale, scheme and language and writes the GIF, and the pictures leave the container as an archive, into docs/images, in English and German, and store/images, in every language of the extension. After a change of main, every release and every week, the screenshot bot runs the script and opens a pull request with the pictures whose pixels changed.
